about: Quick picks shown when someone screens a place without saying what's planned there (js/workspace.js, askAssetType). Order matters: the first six that suit the setting (on land or at sea) show as buttons, the rest under More…, and 'Just a general screen' is always there. Energy-led for now (Rob, 20 Nov); to widen the customer base, add or reorder entries here. Each `type` must be an asset in catalogue/distances.json. `onshore`/`offshore` give a different type by setting; `only` limits an entry to one setting.
